title: 第3章 现场洞房
content_zh:
梅语嫣并非是一个人露面的，在她的身边还跟着一个高大英俊的年轻人，讨好似的替她开路。

年轻人叫钱大兵，是平安一中的体育老师，凭着不错的外在条件，经常勾搭学校女老师和漂亮的女学生，甚至曾经让一名女老师怀孕，却又抛弃了对方，总之名声很臭。若不是跟校领导有关系，早就被开除了。

钱大兵的出现，无疑坐实了之前知情者所吐露的消息，也让无数男生揪紧了心，生怕美女老师被猪油蒙了心，掉进了钱大兵这头色狼的陷阱里。

“你就是梅语嫣？”在警戒线边缘，高队长拦住了梅语嫣的去路。

“不错。”梅语嫣神情凄婉的回道。

“劫持犯一直要求跟你见面，你现在的行为举止很关键。”确认了对方的身份，高队长交代道：“希望你能尽量安抚人质的情绪，不要再有任何刺激他的举动，尽快让他放弃对人质的挟持和伤害。”

“我尽力。”梅语嫣捏着发白的指节，用力地点了点头。

眼见梅语嫣穿过警戒线，朝赵铁柱走过去，高队长眉头皱了皱，却没有阻拦，而是朝身旁一名警员吩咐道：“让狙击手准备吧，上面已经下了死命令，五分钟之内如果不能劝降劫持者，就直接击毙。”

“语嫣，你不要再过去了。那人是个疯子，你靠地太近会有危险。”钱大兵一把抓住了梅语嫣的胳膊。

“放开！钱老师，你我只是同事的关系，我的事情，还轮不到你来管。”梅语嫣回头看向钱大兵，一反往日温婉柔弱的性子，目光坚定的说道。

钱大兵顿时有些语塞，手不自觉的松开了，梅语嫣再也没看他一眼，脚步沉重的朝对面走去。

“看起来柔弱生怜，没想到倒是很有胆色。”一直盯着梅语嫣的秦朗，不由暗暗点头。

这种时候，梅语嫣敢不顾危险走过来，确实让他另眼相看。

反观那个钱大兵，就不免让秦朗觉得可笑了。他早看出来这个钱大兵拉住梅语嫣的举动，并不是真的担心对方的安危，而是不敢跟着梅语嫣一起靠近赵铁柱这个凶徒。现在梅语嫣走过来，他却磨磨蹭蹭的在原地不敢再跟着了。

对于这样的人，秦朗向来嗤之以鼻。

梅语嫣浑身一颤，不得不收住了脚步，她看着赵铁柱深吸了一口气道：“铁柱哥，你们家对我有恩，我一直铭记于心，但是感情的事情不能勉强，你何苦要这么做呢？”

赵铁柱疯癫般的大笑起来，“我为什么这么做？老子这么做还不是因为你给逼的？”

两行清泪从梅语嫣的眼角滑落，流淌在吹弹可破的脸庞上，她伸手抹去眼泪，泣声道：“铁柱哥，事情发展到这一步，我也不想再解释什么，千错万错都是我一个人的错，你把那个学生放了，他是无辜的，你心里有气就冲着我来。”

“梅语嫣，你别说这些废话，你要是真想救这学生，那就答应我一个条件，和我结婚，否则就别在这里扮好人。”赵铁柱咄咄逼人的说道。

“你他妈是白日做梦！”钱大兵忽然走到了梅语嫣的身旁，朝赵铁柱大声道：“也不照照镜子看清楚自己是哪颗葱，就凭你也想娶语嫣，真是癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉。”

“你给老子闭嘴，早上你打我的事情，老子还没跟你算账呢。再他妈敢废话，我就杀了你，杀你全家。”赵铁柱看到这个钱大兵，好像受到了巨大刺激一般，眼里冒火，面目狰狞，嘶哑着嗓门，暴躁的喊道。

钱大兵的脸上闪过一丝畏惧，不过想到这赵铁柱接下来的下场，他又定下心来，根本不理会对方乃至人质的安全，而是转头劝说起梅语嫣。

“该死，钱大兵这么刺激我身后的家伙，岂不是摆明了要坏我的性命么？”秦朗咬牙切齿的盯着钱大兵，算是把他给记恨上了。

要不是此刻受制于人，他真想上去，将这人的嘴巴抽烂。

警察也意识到钱大兵的做法，只会进一步刺激劫匪，对人质造成伤害，所以立刻上前将他拉下了场。

没有了钱大兵的干扰，梅语嫣朝赵铁柱坚定的说道：“铁柱哥，我答应你了，你把人放了吧。”

“那铁柱哥你说怎么办才肯相信我。”

“咱们现场把证办了，只要你答应，我就立刻放人。”

“好，我答应你，咱们现场办证。”梅语嫣毫不犹豫的点点头。

赵铁柱听到这个回答，情绪似乎安定了一些，可下一秒又像想起什么似的，情绪又突然激动了起来。

“不行，领了证还不代表什么，老子今天一定要得到你的身子！领完证后，我们就在后面的教室洞房，这么多人见证，既定事实，你是赖不掉的！”

人群里顿时传来一阵嘘声，赵铁柱的要求，把现场气氛推向了另一个**。

梅语嫣脸上又红又烫，显得极难为情。

“怎么，不答应了？”赵铁柱回想多年来的种种，顿时恼羞成怒，“梅语嫣你这个贱人，你可是跟老子订过亲的，以前不让我上就算了，领了证还不情愿？告诉你，我赵铁柱的便宜不是这么好沾的。我把话放在这里，你生是我赵家人，死是我赵家鬼！”

说着，他刀锋一指钱大兵：“我就要当着你奸夫的面干死你！”

听到这样的污言秽语，现场所有人都大皱眉头。

梅语嫣咬咬牙道：“铁柱哥你别急，我答应你，你说怎样做，我就怎样做。”

赵铁柱顿时心满意足，一想起梅语嫣即将要脱光了的模样，他就像着了魔似的，瞬间欲血沸腾，连架在人质脖子上的刀都稍稍推的远了一些。

一直注意着场中变化的高队长看到这一幕，眼前一亮，抬手看看表，五分钟的时间已经到了，便朝某个方向悄悄做了一个手势。

早已经埋伏在隐蔽处的狙击手看到这个手势，迅速进入狙击状态，准星瞄准了赵铁柱的脑袋。

岂料，就在狙击手抓住时机即将扣动扳机的时候，赵铁柱犹如神助一般，脸色突然大变，一指梅语嫣道：“你这个贱人敢骗我。”

话音一摞，他猛地揪住秦朗的脖子，把身体要害都藏在秦朗身躯后面，快速的朝后退去。

一边退，他还一边喊道：“妈的，你们这帮警察有种就开枪，老子就算死，也要拉个垫背的。”

“不可能，他怎么会发现狙击手？难道这人虽然疯，但第六感超常？”高队长心里头的惊讶难以言表。

实际上，高队长猜得不错，赵铁柱确实拥有超常的第六感，特别是对于危险，有种敏锐的感知力。

正因为如此，在狙击手瞄准他的时候，他竟然意外的有了感知，眼睛四下一扫，居然还真就让他发现了狙击手的存在。

“我没有骗你。”梅语嫣压根没有意识到发生了什么，看到赵铁柱的动作，只能努力的辩驳。

“贱人，我告诉你，就算老子死了，变成鬼也不会放过你。”

赵铁柱不再听任何话，警方的狙击行动让他情绪再度失控，到达了爆发的边缘。

他以秦朗做肉盾，迫使狙击手不敢贸然开抢，短短时间就成功躲过了狙击手的锁定，顺利的退入到教学楼一间空置的教室里。

整个过程，秦朗看似吓傻了一般，任由摆布。

但实际上，秦朗一直不断的做着规律的呼吸，腹部胀缩不止，悄然将力气集中起来，养精蓄锐，等待爆发的时机。
content_en:
Mei Yuyan did not show up alone. There was a tall and handsome young man beside her, trying to please her and paving the way for her.

The young man's name is Qian Dabing, and he is a physical education teacher at Ping'an No. 1 Middle School. With his good external conditions, he often hooks up with female teachers and beautiful female students in the school. He even got a female teacher pregnant but then abandoned her. In short, he has a bad reputation.If he hadn't been related to the school leaders, he would have been expelled long ago.

The appearance of Qian Dabing undoubtedly confirmed the information previously disclosed by insiders, and also made countless boys tighten their hearts, fearing that the beautiful teacher would be deceived by lard and fall into the trap of Qian Dabing, a pervert.

"Are you Mei Yuyan?" At the edge of the cordon, Captain Gao blocked Mei Yuyan's path.

"Not bad." Mei Yuyan replied sadly.

"The hijacker has been asking to meet with you. Your current behavior is very important." After confirming the identity of the other party, Captain Gao explained: "I hope you can try to calm the hostage's emotions, stop any actions to irritate him, and make him give up holding hostages and harming the hostages as soon as possible."

"I'll try my best." Mei Yuyan pinched her white knuckles and nodded vigorously.

Seeing Mei Yuyan crossing the cordon and walking towards Zhao Tiezhu, Captain Gao frowned, but did not stop him. Instead, he ordered a police officer next to him: "Let the sniper prepare. A death order has been issued. If the hijacker cannot be persuaded to surrender within five minutes, he will be killed directly."

"Yu Yan, don't go there anymore. That person is a lunatic, and you will be in danger if you get too close to the ground." Qian Dabing grabbed Mei Yuyan's arm.

"Let go! Teacher Qian, you and I are just colleagues. It's not your turn to take care of my affairs." Mei Yuyan looked back at Qian Dabing, and said with firm eyes, contrary to her usual gentle and weak temper.

Qian Dabing was suddenly at a loss for words and unconsciously let go of his hand. Mei Yuyan never looked at him again and walked towards the opposite side with heavy steps.

"It looks weak and pitiful, but I didn't expect it to be very courageous." Qin Lang, who had been staring at Mei Yuyan, couldn't help but nodded secretly.

At this time, Mei Yuyan dared to come over regardless of the danger, which really made him look at her in a new light.

Looking back at Qian Dabing, Qin Lang couldn't help but find it ridiculous.He had already seen that when Qian Dabing held Mei Yuyan, he was not really worried about the other party's safety, but he did not dare to follow Mei Yuyan to get close to the murderer Zhao Tiezhu.Now that Mei Yuyan came over, he hesitated to follow her.

Qin Lang has always scorned such people.

Mei Yuyan trembled and had to stop her steps. She looked at Zhao Tiezhu and took a deep breath and said, "Brother Tiezhu, I will always remember your family's kindness to me, but you can't force things about feelings. Why do you have to do this?"

Zhao Tiezhu laughed like crazy, "Why did I do this? Isn't it because you forced me to do this?"

Two lines of clear tears fell from the corners of Mei Yuyan's eyes and flowed on her face that could be broken by bullets. She stretched out her hand to wipe away the tears and cried: "Brother Tiezhu, when things have come to this point, I don't want to explain anything. All the mistakes are my fault alone. You let that student go. He is innocent. If you are angry, come to me."

"Mei Yuyan, don't talk such nonsense. If you really want to save this student, then agree to one condition and marry me. Otherwise, stop pretending to be a good person here." Zhao Tiezhu said aggressively.

"You're fucking daydreaming!" Qian Dabing suddenly walked up to Mei Yuyan and shouted to Zhao Tiezhu: "You don't even look in the mirror to see clearly which onion you are. Just because you want to marry Yuyan, you really want to eat swan meat."

"Shut up, I haven't settled the score with you for beating me up this morning. If you dare to talk nonsense again, I will kill you and your whole family." When Zhao Tiezhu saw this Qian Dabing, he seemed to be greatly stimulated. His eyes were on fire, his face was ferocious, and he yelled irritably in a hoarse voice.

A trace of fear flashed across Qian Dabing's face, but thinking of Zhao Tiezhu's next fate, he calmed down and ignored the safety of the other party and even the hostages. Instead, he turned to persuade Mei Yuyan.

"Damn it, Qian Dabing is so irritating the guy behind me, isn't it clear that he wants to destroy my life?" Qin Lang gritted his teeth and stared at Qian Dabing, feeling like he had a grudge against him.

If he hadn't been controlled by someone at this moment, he would have really wanted to go up and beat this man's mouth to pieces.

The police also realized that Qian Dabing's actions would only further stimulate the robbers and cause harm to the hostages, so they immediately stepped forward and pulled him off.

Without the interference of Qian Dabing, Mei Yuyan said firmly to Zhao Tiezhu: "Brother Tiezhu, I promise you, please let him go."

"Then Brother Tiezhu, what can you tell me to do before you believe me?"

"We have obtained the certificate on the spot. As long as you agree, I will release you immediately."

"Okay, I promise you, we will apply for the certificate on the spot." Mei Yuyan nodded without hesitation.

When Zhao Tiezhu heard this answer, his mood seemed to calm down a little, but the next second he seemed to think of something, and his mood suddenly became excited again.

"No, getting the certificate doesn't mean anything. I must get your body today! After getting the certificate, we will have a wedding in the classroom at the back. With so many people witnessing it, you can't rely on the established fact!"

There was a burst of boos from the crowd, and Zhao Tiezhu's request pushed the atmosphere to another level.

Mei Yuyan's face was red and hot, and she looked extremely embarrassed.

"Why, you don't agree?" Zhao Tiezhu recalled everything that happened over the years, and suddenly became angry, "Mei Yuyan, you bitch, you have been engaged to me, but you didn't let me get married before, and you are still unwilling to get the certificate? Let me tell you, I, Zhao Tiezhu, am not so easy to take advantage of. Let me put it here, you are my Zhao family in life, and you are my Zhao family ghost in death!"

As he spoke, he pointed his blade at Qian Dabing and said, "I'm going to kill you in front of your adulterer!"

Hearing such dirty words, everyone at the scene frowned.

Mei Yuyan gritted her teeth and said, "Brother Tiezhu, don't worry, I promise you, I will do whatever you tell me to do."

Zhao Tiezhu was immediately satisfied. When he thought of Mei Yuyan's appearance about to take off her clothes, he felt like he was possessed. His blood boiled with desire, and he even pushed the knife on the hostage's neck a little further.

Captain Gao, who had been paying attention to the changes in the field, saw this scene, and his eyes lit up. He raised his hand and looked at his watch. Five minutes had passed, and he quietly made a gesture in a certain direction.

The sniper who had been ambushing in the hiding place saw this gesture and quickly entered sniper mode, aiming at Zhao Tiezhu's head.

Unexpectedly, just when the sniper seized the opportunity and was about to pull the trigger, Zhao Tiezhu, like a divine help, suddenly changed his face, pointed at Mei Yuyan and said: "You bitch, how dare you lie to me."

As soon as he finished speaking, he suddenly grabbed Qin Lang's neck, hid his body's vitals behind Qin Lang's body, and quickly retreated.

While retreating, he shouted: "Damn it, you policemen will shoot if you dare. Even if I die, I will have someone to support me."

"Impossible, how could he find the sniper? Could it be that although this man is crazy, his sixth sense is extraordinary?" Captain Gao's surprise was beyond words.

In fact, Captain Gao guessed well. Zhao Tiezhu did have an extraordinary sixth sense, especially a keen perception of danger.

Because of this, when the sniper was aiming at him, he unexpectedly sensed it. He glanced around, and he actually discovered the sniper's existence.

"I didn't lie to you." Mei Yuyan didn't realize what happened at all. Seeing Zhao Tiezhu's actions, she could only argue hard.

"Bitch, let me tell you, even if I die and become a ghost, I will not let you go."

Zhao Tiezhu no longer listened to anything. The police sniper operation made him lose control of his emotions again and reached the edge of explosion.

He used Qin Lang as a human shield to force the sniper to dare not rush to grab. In a short time, he successfully evaded the sniper's lock and successfully retreated into an empty classroom in the teaching building.

During the whole process, Qin Lang seemed to be frightened and allowed himself to be manipulated.

But in fact, Qin Lang has been breathing regularly, his abdomen is expanding and contracting, quietly concentrating his strength, recharging his energy, and waiting for the opportunity to explode.
